item3_common_subset.scoring: Every method (rule-prior, params, learned-disc, acoustic), ModePrior (evaluator baseline, leave-capture-out) and controls are scored on EXACTLY these 1,000 dev.T1 items. Predictions may come from existing frozen-run files (restricted to these items) or from new runs of the frozen code on these groups (e.g. --exclude the complement); no method file, model or parameter may change. Items without a prediction are abstentions: uniform 8-bit log loss, tie-aware top-1 = 1/256, never called. Report top-1, mean log2 loss, bits/group and bytes called at the item-4 thresholds with achieved precision, group-bootstrap 95% CIs (2,000 resamples over groups, default_rng(20261128)), the number of supplied predictions, and per capture. learned-disc rows carry the label IN-SAMPLE.

item4_threshold_rule.rule: For each method m, precision target p in {0.995 (primary), 0.98 (secondary)} and unit u in {bytes, bits}: on dev.T1 groups OUTSIDE the common subset, compute separately for each DEV capture c the empirical cutoff t(m,u,p,c) = eval_mask_predictions.at_precision(conf, correct, p)["threshold"] (largest confidence-ranked set with precision >= p, never splitting equal confidences). Leave-one-capture-out: the cutoff fitted on one capture is the one applied to the other; the registered threshold is the STRICTER (higher) of the two, T(m,u,p) = max(t(hik), t(merged), floor_u), floor_bytes = 0.6, floor_bits = 0.9. If no non-empty set reaches p on a capture, that capture's t is +inf and nothing is called.

confidence.bytes: max over the 256-way distribution (evaluator byte_scores confidence; correct = tie-aware top-1)
confidence.bits: max(p1, 1-p1) of each MSB-first bit marginal (evaluator bit_scores; ties at 0.5 count 0.5)

item4_threshold_rule.missing_predictions: Missing predictions are abstentions: they are never called (called count from missing items must be 0, asserted by the scorer), they enter log loss as uniform, and the number of missing items is reported. Threshold fitting uses only items that have predictions.
item4_threshold_rule.application: A sealed or out-of-sample readout calls an item iff conf >= T(m,u,p); report called count, called correct, achieved precision with a Clopper-Pearson 95% interval, and bits/group. The evaluator CLI short summary (empirical counts) is NOT a readout; only this rule (or the full JSON frozen block fed with T) is.
item4_threshold_rule.sources: Existing frozen DEV prediction files may be used (rule-prior final/dev.T1.full.npz; params final/dev.T1.npz; learned-disc pred/dev.T1.full.npz and pred/dev.T1.ctx.npz; acoustic dev.T1.pred.npz), restricted to groups outside the common subset; new frozen-code runs on further outside groups are allowed. Report groups/items per capture behind each cutoff; flag any capture with fewer than 50 groups as small-sample.
item4_threshold_rule.sensitivity: Secondary only: the same cutoffs also excluding the method's own item-2 tuning groups. learned-disc cutoffs are in-sample by construction and are labelled so.
item4_threshold_rule.replaces: The DEV-picked frozen thresholds in the freezes (fitted on the same items they were reported on) are not used for any readout under this registration.

item5_live_set_rule.sources: DU archives in item1.du_archives with use == "live_source" only. Exclusions are listed there with reasons (bit repair, multi-receiver combining, altered IQ, the nov27-dev source). msc.bin / packet archives are parsed with the repository's existing transport code; a DU is admitted only if all 4 packets passed header and packet CRC in the archive and the DU CRC-16 (tail_fill_audit.crc over du[:-2] vs du[-2:], big-endian) passes. No packet or DU repair of any kind. When the same (counter, phase) appears in more than one admitted archive, the DUs must be byte-identical, otherwise the whole counter is dropped and counted.
item5_live_set_rule.group: a counter with CRC-valid DUs for phases 0, 1 and 2
item5_live_set_rule.gate: Fill crib at the best phase: for p in 0..2, ks_p = du_p[698:714] XOR 0xBB; decrypt the other two tails with ks_p; score_p = number of plausible UTF-16LE code units among those 16, plausible = 0xAC00..0xD7A3 or 0x20..0x7E or 0x0A, 0x0D, 0x2103, 0xB0, and never 0xBBBB (work/catchup/design/fillcrib_vs_keys.py). Best phase = argmax score_p. Admit iff max score_p >= 15 (of 16) and no other phase with a DIFFERENT key also reaches 15 (ambiguous -> drop, counted). Label = ks_best = ks[0..15]: ks[0..10] is visible role 0, ks[11..15] are the T1 targets. DEV calibration quoted from the catch-up: >=15 agreed with CRC-supported contrib keys in 318/318 (hik) and 174/174 (merged) groups; >=14 gave 6 wrong keys.

counter_disjointness.rule: A live counter is dropped if it (a) appears in any DEV npz (dev, nov27-dev, syn-dev inputs), (b) lies within [min-1500, max+1500] of ANY contrib/kcbsdrm/keys archive's counter range, (c) lies inside any sealed-capture window derived from split.json metadata only (nominal start time -> counter at 1.2 s/counter, window [start-3600, start+7200]) or equals a counter listed in split.json, or (d) lies in [43854885-1500, 43854910+1500] (nov27-dev). Sealed npz files are never read.

item5_live_set_rule.decoder_check: Each admitted group's 15 role-0 frames decoded alone (all other slots erased) with ks[0..10] by the traced decoder (work/benchmark/tools/evs_dec_traced/EVS_dec_traced, as in the benchmark label check); flags = bfi or BER_detect on a supplied frame. Wrong-key control: same frames with the role-0 key of the admitted group half the session list away. Reported per session and pooled.
item5_live_set_rule.per_capture: Sessions are formed by sorting admitted counters and starting a new session at any gap > 750 counters (15 min); each session is reported separately with its source archives, plus the pooled total. The member 3205 kHz archive is reported as its own row even where Edogawa 6140 kHz DUs overlap it.
item5_live_set_rule.wrong_group_control: Every method is also run on the live inputs with its built-in --control wrong-group (acoustic: --control wrong-key); if a method lacks one, its predictions are deranged across groups within a session (no fixed points, default_rng(20261128)). Control top-1 above 0.05 flags that method's live numbers as leakage-suspect.
item5_live_set_rule.format: inputs/truth npz in the dev.T1 layout (split "live", task "T1"); built and SHA-256 sealed BEFORE any method is run on it; thresholds are the item-4 values, unchanged.
item5_live_set_rule.archive_counter_spans_note: see item1.du_archives (counter_min/counter_max are archive metadata, not scores)

data.rule: 10 blocks of 10 consecutive groups (100 groups, 6,000 frames): one block per syn-dev source (sorted order) with start drawn by default_rng(20261129); a 10th non-overlapping block from the largest source (ties broken by name: librivox-ko-hyun-01), redrawn until disjoint from that source's first block. Each block is decoded from decoder reset under every condition.

item6_oracle_decode.decoder: stock work/evs_gcc_independent/EVS_dec at 32 kHz (G.192 input; erased slots as BFI words); the same binary for all conditions

conditions.name: full_oracle
conditions.desc: all 44 mask bytes true; every frame decrypted (reference)

conditions.name: role0_only
conditions.desc: role-0 frames with true mask; roles 1-3 erased

conditions.name: role0+role1_j04_partial
conditions.desc: role 0 true; role-1 frames supplied with j0-4 true and j5-10 left as ciphertext (mask taken as 0); roles 2-3 erased

conditions.name: role0+role1_erased
conditions.desc: identical to D1; the D2a vs D2b pair answers "partial role-1 frames vs erasure"

conditions.name: role0+role1_full
conditions.desc: role 0 and role 1 fully true; roles 2-3 erased (role-1 ceiling)

conditions.name: +roles2-3_j04_partial
conditions.desc: as D2a plus role-2 and role-3 frames supplied with j0-4 true, j5-9 ciphertext (role-3 j10 clear)

conditions.name: +roles2-3_erased
conditions.desc: identical to D2a; pair D3a vs D3b

conditions.name: per_byte_knockout
conditions.desc: D0 with mask index m (0..42, 43 conditions) replaced by true XOR r, r uniform in 1..255 per (group, m), default_rng(20261130); degradation vs D0 per (role, j)

conditions.name: ungated_argmax
conditions.desc: indices 0-15 true; the 27 hidden bytes set to the argmax of the frozen rule-prior syn-dev.TH predictions (work/methods/rule-prior/final/syn-dev.TH.full.npz) regardless of confidence; all frames supplied. Secondary: learned-disc ctx (pred/syn-dev.TH.ctx.npz, cross-fit by source fold). Groups inside rule-prior's syn-dev.TH tuning set are reported separately

conditions.name: full_oracle_check
conditions.desc: D0 decoded again through CandidateDecoder(rate 32000) to tie item-7 decoder equivalence to the same streams

metrics.reference: D0 PCM of the same block (codec ceiling); primary window excludes the first group (1.2 s warm-up), whole block secondary
metrics.LSD: 20 ms Hann frames (640 samples), 10 ms hop, power spectra + 1e-10; per-frame sqrt(mean_k (10log10 Pref - 10log10 Ptest)^2) dB; mean over frames whose reference RMS > -50 dBFS
metrics.segSNR: 20 ms non-overlapping frames, 10log10(sum ref^2 / sum (ref-test)^2) clipped to [-10, 35] dB, mean over frames with reference RMS > -50 dBFS
metrics.reporting: per block and pooled mean with block-bootstrap 95% CI (2,000 resamples, default_rng(20261128)); per (role, j) table for D4

dropped if its mean log2 loss on the common subset is not strictly below ModePrior's on the same 1,000 items (point estimate; paired group-bootstrap CI reported)

marked SUSPECT if fork-snapshot CandidateDecoder PCM differs from stock EVS_dec under erasures: any 20 ms int16 frame not bit-identical on the D1/D2a block timelines or on examples/receiver-control/result/received.192.gz; if the erasure-free D0 timelines also differ, acoustic is suspect for that reason instead
